note.windows: Needs your own USA .z64 of Star Wars Episode I: Racer and a DirectX 12 GPU. The first build takes 30 to 60 minutes and about 8 GB. Git, Python, CMake and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once.
note.linux: Needs your own USA .z64 of Star Wars Episode I: Racer and a Vulkan GPU driver. The first build takes 20 to 40 minutes and about 6 GB. Clang, CMake, Ninja, Python and the SDL2, GTK 3 and X11 development packages are installed with your package manager (apt, dnf or pacman) if they are missing; it asks for your password once.
note.darwin: Needs your own USA .z64 of Star Wars Episode I: Racer, an Apple Silicon Mac and Xcode (for its Metal shader compiler; install it from the App Store first). The first build takes 20 to 40 minutes and about 6 GB. CMake, Ninja and SDL2 are installed with Homebrew if they are missing.
